<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087032026-06-1505-15-24" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="223.212.212 mngon suM tshad ma yin pa la ma yin par rtogs pa dgag pa"/>
         mngon suM tshad ma {} yin pa la ma yin par rtogs pa dgag pa ni 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3809">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><choice><reg><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3809">jo</rs></reg><orig>(jo)</orig></choice></note><note type="editorial">Tentative identification of "jo" as "jo btsun", another appellation of Khyung rin chen grags (ID:3809)</note> rtog pa yul dus rnam pa la 'khrul pa'i tshe de dang lhan cig pa'i rtog med kyang bum pa tsam la tshad mar mi 'gyur te | 'di ltar rtog pas snam bu'i dmar po la bum pa'i dmar po yin no zhes rnam pa la 'khrul pa'i tshe de dang lhan cig pa'i mig shes kyang dmar po tsam la tshad ma ma yin te | bum pa'i dmar por bcad de dngos po la mi <lb n="21b4"/> gnas la | snam bu'i dmar por dngos po la gnas te blos ma bcad cing de gnyis spangs pa'i dmar po tsam de na med pa'i phyir ro || gal te de tshad ma yin na ni dung ser por snang pa yang dbyibs la tshad mar 'gyur te mtshungs pa'i phyir ro || de bzhin du yul sgo rgyab dang 'brel pa'i bum pa la khang phugs dang 'brel par 'khrul pa'i tshe yang rtog med mig shes bum pa tsam la tshad mar mi 'gyur zhing | 
         <note type="editorial">N.above the line: gal te 'gyur na ?['gal me αla khor lor] 'khrul pa yang dmar po tsam la tshad mar 'gyur te mtshungs paso |. α It seems that "lo" was written and that the "naro" was erased.</note> 
         yang dus phyi dro dang 'bre[l] <lb n="21b5"/> pa'i srog chags snga dro dang 'brel par 'khrul pa'i tshe rtog med srog chags tsam ldog la tshad mar mi 'gyur ro zhes zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
